# Gas Mining and Storage Gasses are often permanently used. Whether they are lost to [textlink="space" link="Spacing"] or used in a burn chamber, the station needs to be able to produce more gas to replace what is lost. It also needs to store this gas in a safe and efficient manner.
## Gas Miners Gas miners are used to replenish the station's gas supply. They are found in the gas storage tanks in Atmospherics.
Gas miners constantly produce room temperature gas and push it into the exposed atmosphere. They require no power to function, and never stop working unless they have reached the defined [bold]cutoff pressure[/bold].
You can see more information about the gas miners by inspecting them using [color=yellow][bold][keybind="ExamineEntity"][/bold][/color]. Try inspecting the gas miners presented above.
Gas miners come in tiers, with the larger versions having a higher pressure cutoff than the smaller versions.
If gas miners are ever unanchored from the station, they can be reanchored using a regular wrench.
## Gas Storage Gas storage tanks are used to store gas produced by the gas miners, and to make it available to other processes. They are found in Atmospherics.
[color=#999999][italic]Um exemplo de um pequeno tanque de armazenamento de gás[italic][/color]
Vários processos atmosféricos introduzem e removem gases dos tanques de armazenamento de gás. Por exemplo: - O minerador de gás fornece gases frescos aos tanques de armazenamento de gás, se houver espaço. - O sistema de reciclagem injeta gases recuperados nos tanques de armazenamento de gás para reutilização. - Sistemas como o *distronet* e a câmara de queima removem gases dos tanques de armazenamento de gás.
Os tanques de armazenamento de gás são projetados para que possam ser medidos usando um [textlink="Gas Analyzer" link="AtmosTools"]. Porque a saída de escoamento é uma [textlink="passive vent" link="PassiveVent"], você pode usar um [textlink="gas analyzer" link="AtmosTools"] para medir o conteúdo de gás do [textlink="pump's" link="Pumps"] entrada, que provém do tanque de armazenamento de gás.
